title: Characterization of buffered computation
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, and let $x,w$ be Boolean words. The buffered sequential composition computes $w$ from $x$ in some finite number of steps if and only if there is a Boolean word $y$ such that $M_1$ computes $y$ from $x$ in some finite number of steps and $M_2$ computes $w$ from $y$ in some finite number of steps.
hypotheses_covered: $M_1,M_2$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
